The Petitioner‟s contention that it initiated the exercise of acquiring land based on an assurance given by MEDA on a clarification sought by it is not sustainable as the Petitioner had sought clarification as to whether wind power projects which would be developed as ISTS connected projects for SECI were required to be registered with MEDA. The query sought by the Petitioner has no relevance in the present case as Petitioner was never a participant in the SECI bid or any other bid. Thus, having taken a business decision to acquire land even before applying for Stage-I connectivity with the Respondent, and that too, on the basis of a clarification which did not pertain to its case, the Petitioner cannot now use the same as grounds for seeking any relaxation from the Detailed Procedure, 2018. 23.
